message: I've added a shield icon beside the title on slide 2.

slides.content_brief: Three short bullets: a passkey only works on the real site, so a fake sign-in page gets nothing; there is no secret to reuse or leak; the private key never leaves the device. Close with a callout: a passkey cannot be phished Place {{image:0gRwFgCXETSpBNcZ9TP8IPNYqgJWXsPr724YH0pC-Yo}} as a small shield icon beside the slide title, about 64px square.
slides.assumes: The audience has seen a phishing email that asked for a password
slides.hands_off: Passkeys remove the thing attackers steal
